# Off-GPU inventory

**GPU 100% target: every site below ticked off, nothing off the GPU.**

Generated by `node scripts/off-gpu-scan.mjs --doc` (`npm run offgpu`); do not edit by hand. The checklist at the end is regenerated from the scan, so a site leaves it when it moves to the GPU.
No percentage blocks a push or a deploy; the honest score is printed and the target is 100%. What each category means is at the top of the script.

**841/5203 on GPU (16% honest, counting 789 class-write and timer/observer sites; target 100%), 4362 off: frame path 2502, during use 1851, no caller found 9; 414 setup sites left out of the count and listed; 1562 tagged run-once/rare allocations (// alloc-rare: reason) also left out, listed with their reasons; per-frame view (event-only sites set aside): 841/3352 on GPU (25%), 1851 event-only sites listed apart (timer or rest pass 565, stored callback 315, promise 313, event handler 306, observer 166, store or registry listener 146, event or timer 24, motion handler 7, a method of this name is called from stored callback 5, a method of this name is called from timer or rest pass 3, a method of this name is called from event handler 1)**.

**Warm garbage: 130452 B/frame over 10 frame functions** (compiled, in node; `npm run warm`), all within their limits. stage frame with the vessels (stage.js + veins-gl.js, 60 Hz display, 30 Hz model) 72107 B; pressure-time chart drawn by the GPU pen (pressure-time.js + trace-gl.js, update and redraw) 15413 B; display-state: colour follows, scalar follows and the shown state, a frame of each 1022 B; label-gl: reading 30 labels (describeBlock, svgOnly, lookKey), as a sync reads those that changed 35705 B; glass-gl: the blur plan of eight glasses (blurBoxesInto), a picture 2 B; blood.advanceStream, 40 streams 2290 B; pressure-time ingest (real engine frames) 3907 B; flow-rows changedRows + retireRows + flowClose 2 B; uniform-cache, a frame of fifty uniforms 2 B; veins-bin splitCells into a kept record 2 B.
